questions.questionTextEn: Which of the following instruments is used to record seismic waves?
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P. P.C.S. (Mains) 2017] Which of the following instruments is used to record seismic waves?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Seismograph. A seismograph is an instrument used to detect and record earthquakes. The seismometer is the internal part of the seismograph, which may be a pendulum or a weight mounted on a spring. However, it is also commonly used as a synonym for seismograph. [U.P. P.C.S. (Mains) 2017]

questions.questionTextEn: T sunami word belongs to which of the following languages ?
questions.questionTextHi: [Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2005] T sunami word belongs to which of the following languages ?
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) Japanese. Tsunami is a Japanese word "tsu" which means 'Harbor' and "nami" means 'wave'. Thus Tsunami means 'harbor wave' arising as a result of the earthquake. These ruptured high waves may cause substantial damage to coastal areas. [Uttarakhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2005]

questions.questionTextEn: Which one of the following statements about the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and the resulting Tsunami is not correct?
questions.questionTextHi: [47th B.P.S.C. (Pre) 2005] Which one of the following statements about the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and the resulting Tsunami is not correct?
optionsEn: The earthquake originated due to slipping of about 1,200 km of fault line by 15 m along the subduction zone where the India Plate subducts the Burma plate at the Sunda Trench.
The resulting tsunami devastated the shores ranging from the coast of Indonesia to the east coast of Africa, some 8,500 km away from the epicentre.
As per the current estimates, the quake-generated tsunami killed more than 50 lakh people, in addition to unaccounted dead bodies swept out to sea.
Bangladesh had very few casualties because the quake-affected fault line was in a nearly north-south orientation, the greatest strength of the tsunami waves was in an east-west direction.

questions.questionTextEn: The North-Western Region of the Indian Sub-continent is susceptible to earthquake activity because of –
questions.questionTextHi: [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2005] The North-Western Region of the Indian Sub-continent is susceptible to earthquake activity because of –
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (B) plate tectonic activity. North-Western region of Indian Subcontinent is susceptible to earthquake activities because it is situated at the border of plates. This area is convergence region of Indian Plate and Eurasian Plate. Coral formation activities and volcanic activities do not occur here. [U.P.P.C.S. (Mains) 2005]
